prompt: Create a vertical diptych-style composition split into two distinct halves. The top half is a photorealistic, high-resolution photograph of a humpback whale's tail fluke rising vertically out of the deep blue ocean. The water is textured with white foam and splashing droplets around the base of the tail. In the background, there are soft-focus blue mountains under a bright sky with scattered clouds. The bottom half is a minimalist illustration on a pale blue-grey paper texture background. It features a stylized black ink drawing of the same whale tail shape, but rendered entirely using a pointillism or stippling technique (composed of thousands of tiny dots). Include specific Korean typography in the bottom section: 'No. 027' in small text at the top left, followed by a large title '먼바다로 가는 꼬리' and a smaller subtitle '먼 곳을 향한 꼬리'. At the very bottom center, include the scientific name 'Megaptera novaeangliae · 해양 포유류' in a serif font.

promptZh: 创作一幅垂直双联画风格的构图，画面分为上下两个截然不同的部分。上半部分是一张照片级真实感的高清摄影作品：一只座头鲸的尾鳍从深蓝色的海洋中垂直跃出水面。尾鳍根部周围的海水泛起白色泡沫与飞溅的水珠。背景是明亮天空下点缀着朵朵白云、呈现柔焦效果的蓝色群山。下半部分是一幅极简插画，以浅蓝灰色的纸张纹理为背景。画面主体是同一鲸鱼尾鳍造型的风格化黑色水墨画，但完全采用点彩或点刻技法绘制（由成千上万个微小圆点组成）。在下半部分加入特定的韩文排版：左上角以小字标注“No. 027”，下方是大号标题“먼바다로 가는 꼬리”以及较小的副标题“먼 곳을 향한 꼬리”。在画面最底部居中位置，使用衬线字体标注学名“Megaptera novaeangliae · 해양 포유류”。
